verdict.rationale: Relay's own docs say you can open up to 20 checking accounts and auto-transfer every deposit, splitting it from one account to many by dollar amount or percentage. Profit First-style nicknamed accounts round this out. A community review independently confirms the automatic partitioning, and reviewers praise the ability to open many accounts. The one community mention of glitches with account transfers is a general complaint, not a concrete failure of auto-allocation, so it doesn't create a dispute. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party setup documentation for the deposit-allocation rules (triggers, timing, limits).
